timeline.summary: Reliance Power announced the lapse of 12.50 crore outstanding warrants in April 2026 due to non-conversion.
US Exim filed an application under Section 7 of IBC against Reliance Power alleging a net debt default of USD 165.41 million by subsidiary Samalkot Power.
Reliance Power monitoring agency report shows ₹1,525 Cr preferential warrants proceeds fully utilized by March 2026
In May 2026, the PMLA Adjudicating Authority confirmed the provisional attachment of Reliance Power's assets worth ₹407.60 Cr.
